author: Mollie
text: 18h What if your finance dashboard lived inside your AI assistant? Starting today, it does. We’re introducing official Mollie AI plugins and an open Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for ChatGPT and Claude. Instead of jumping between tabs, logging into multiple tools, and navigating endless menus, you can now run 60+ financial operations directly through natural conversation: 💬 "Create a €120 payment link for Client Jansen that expires in 48 hours." 💬 "Pause the monthly plan for account X until the next billing cycle." 💬 "Show me our top payment methods and average order value over the last 7 days." The AI handles the repetitive prep work in seconds. But because it’s your money, you always hold the keys. No funds move autonomously. Every transaction requires explicit human sign-off, fully backed by your existing Mollie roles, limits, and bank-grade security. Setup takes less than 60 seconds with zero coding required. Ready to bring conversational finance to your workspace? Explore the integration and get started here: https://lnkd.in/esBRw5va …more 175 7 Comments Like Comment Share Ahmed Radwan 14h The docs say the sign-off step depends on the AI client's ask-before-running setting, which Mollie recommends enabling for anything that creates or changes something. Sign-in itself goes through Mollie's OAuth screen with scope capped at the user's role. Can admins enforce that setting centrally in Claude or ChatGPT? text: 1d Can waste paper become a multi-crore business? Childhood friends Naren Raj and Ashutosh Ananth are proving it can. With Rescript Stationery, they've recycled over 500 tonnes of waste paper and saved more than 9,200 trees, all while building a business around something as simple as everyday stationery. Now that's Certified Cool. #CertifiedCool #Razorpay …more 73 3 Comments Like Comment Share Transcript Transcript Sometimes your cofounder is your best friend and sometimes the two of you can turn something as ordinary as waste paper into a multi crore business. That's what Bengaluru childhood friends Nareen Raj and Ashutosh Ananth did when they founded Rescript in 2021. The startup collects discarded office paper and turns it into recycled copier paper and notebooks, products that offices, schools and consumers need everyday. But the real business insight was this. Instead of building a sustainable product, people buy once out of curiosity. They focused on something customers would keep coming back from. Today, Rescript has recycled over 500 tons of waste paper, saved more than 9200 trees and conserved over 18.4 million litres of water, according to the company. text: 2d Almost 1 in 5 AEs who joined Rippling went on to become a sales manager or leader there I teamed up with the Crustdata (YC F24) team and looked at every US Account Executive who joined one of 19 well-known sales orgs between 2018 and 2022. Then we checked how many of them later became a sales manager, director or VP at the same company. Rippling 18% Gusto 17% HubSpot 14% MongoDB 14% Snowflake 12% Datadog 11% Workday 9% Gong 8% Twilio 7% ZoomInfo 6% And at the other end: Salesforce 6%, Stripe 5.5%, Docusign 4%, Zoom 4%, LinkedIn 2.5% These are the most interesting insights imo: > The fastest ladders are at Gong and Rippling. The typical promotion came about 2 years after starting as an AE (22 and 24 months) > Salesforce made the most sales leaders out of its AEs by far (428), but it hired so many AEs that it's still only about 1 in 16 > At Stripe, the typical AE who got promoted waited more than 4 years for it 511 11 Comments Like Comment Share Gauthier GRANDGIRARD 8h Not all AEs want to lead, not all leaders have to come from AE (depending their career stage). Like Reply 1 Reaction Luke Beck 20h Did you track retention as well? Like Reply 2 Reactions Bruno Cecatto 16h I think this correlation has much more to do with a company’s growth stage than anything else. Fast-growing companies naturally need to expand their leadership teams, creating more opportunities for internal promotions. It doesn’t necessarily mean they’re better at developing leaders… Like Reply 1 Reaction Ai
